verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for an agentic commerce and payments platform, so the axis applies. However, the pack documents no retention settings, retention periods, or user/customer data deletion controls. The nearby items do not qualify: catalog replace-mode product deletion, SPT revocation, OCA termination and permissioned account sharing are adjacent access or catalog-management controls, not data retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
